title.value: Learning Neural Implicit Representations with Surface Signal Parameterizations
title.justification: The title corresponds to the focus of the paper, which is about using neural implicit representations to handle surface signal parameterizations.
title.quote: Neural implicit surface representations have recently emerged as popular alternative to explicit 3D object encodings...

extractions.description: The paper presents a novel neural network architecture designed to encode surface parameterizations suitable for appearance data in neural implicit surfaces. This method retains compatibility with existing mesh-based digital content methods and enables applications like texture mapping.
